65.literal: All I can do is endure the pain around the clock.
65.official: So I simply live with the pain.

66.literal: Kiryu-san... [are you familiar with] the capitulum, a head-shaped inflorescence?
66.official: Kiryu-san, are you familiar with the term, "pseudanthium"?

67.literal: It's a gathering of many tiny flowers.
67.official: A cluster of many flowers, gathered to form a single, large flower.

68.literal: Was it Kazama-san who named it "Sunflower"?
68.official: Was it Kazama-san who named the orphanage "Sunflower"?

69.literal: You grew up at the Sunflower, all but brothers with Nishikiyama-san.
69.official: You and Nishikiyama-san grew up as brothers at the Sunflower Orphanage.

70.literal: You followed after Kazama-san into the world of the yakuza.
70.official: You and Nishikiyama-san regarded Kazama-san as a father, in time following in his footsteps to join the yakuza.

71.literal: And now you've been framed for murder,
71.official: And now you find yourself framed for murder, with Kazama-san facing the risk of expulsion as a result.

72.literal: Would you join hands with me, Kiryu-san?
72.official: I would like for you to join me, Kiryu-san.

73.literal: If they get their hands on it, Kazama-san won't escape expulsion.
73.official: If the Dojima Family lieutenants acquire the Empty Lot, Kazama-san's expulsion is a certainty.

74.literal: Why go so far to try to draw me in?
74.official: Why go to the effort of winning me over?

76.literal: Could you at least take my card, then?

77.literal: I'll have your clothes brought over right away.

78.literal: ...I should let Nishiki know, at least, that I made it out safe.
78.official: I should let Nishiki know I'm not dead yet.

79.literal: Hey, seriously? I'm amazed you weren't killed!
79.official: You're okay!? I can't believe you made it out of there alive!

80.literal: They mean to pin the blame on him.
80.official: The family intends to hold him accountable

81.literal: I'll grab Kuze and make him cough up where the real culprit is.
81.official: I'll pay Kuze a visit and make him hand over the killer.

82.literal: Hey, what are you talking about? Don't be so distant.
82.official: Oh, come on. Don't be like that.

83.literal: It's the least I can do to square things, Nishiki. I'll do this by the book.
83.official: This is about me taking accountability, Nishiki. Let me do this right.

84.literal: You think you can just walk right past me without a word?
84.official: Yeah, you seem to think you can just walk by me without a word.

85.literal: I've no intention of trading words with you.

86.literal: Heh, so basically it's a shakedown...
86.official: Heh, so this is a shakedown?

87.literal: Then I'll just take it by force.
87.official: Then I guess we'll do this the hard way.

88.literal: To think I'd have this much trouble with the likes of you...
88.official: If I'm having trouble with somebody like you, I need to change my training regimen.

89.literal: He goes by the nickname "Mr. Shakedown."

90.literal: He takes your money by force.
90.official: He'll go after anybody that crosses his path, and then he takes everything they've got.

91.literal: You might have some confidence in your own skills, but...
91.official: You seem like you can hold your own in a fight, but that guy's on a whole different level.

92.official: He's definitely more than your average tough guy could handle.

93.literal: If only there were someone strong enough to get it back...
93.official: Still! I wish somebody would come along and beat all that stolen money out of him, though!

94.literal: It was my own fault for getting carried away, but...
94.official: I knew I should've made a beeline to the bank with it.

95.literal: You be careful too when you're carrying a lot of cash.
95.official: You be careful too, next time you're sitting on a stack of cash.

96.literal: Mr. Shakedown, huh... His strength was off the charts.
96.official: ("Mr. Shakedown," huh? He was insanely tough.)

97.literal: I may well run into him around here again someday.
97.official: (I probably haven't seen the last of him.)

98.literal: You'll have every last yen on you taken.
98.official: If you lose to Mr. Shakedown in battle, he'll take all the money you have.

99.literal: You can get it back by defeating Mr. Shakedown.
99.official: If you can beat Mr. Shakedown, you'll reclaim all the money he's stolen from you.

100.literal: The cash Mr. Shakedown carries fluctuates depending on the situation.
100.official: The amount he's carrying varies at different times.

101.literal: You can obtain even more money than what was taken from you.
101.official: If you can take him down when he's especially flush with cash, you can make back more than what you've lost.

103.literal: I'm here to collect the protection money.
103.official: Time to pay your protection money, pal.

104.literal: And you're still telling me to pay protection money again!?
104.official: And you have the gall to ask for MORE!?

105.literal: "When it counts"? What are you talking about?
105.official: When you need it? What are you talking about?

106.literal: In short, you got scared of Tachibana Real Estate and ran, didn't you?
106.official: Complicated my ass! You got scared and ran away. What could be simpler?

108.literal: I've got to win back the customers I've lost, and...
108.official: Now I'm scrambling to get new customers to make up for all the ones I lost.

109.literal: It's our family that's got this place's back!
109.official: Our family's handled this cafe's protection for 30 years!

110.literal: If you mean to muscle in on our turf, it's war!
110.official: You try to swoop in on our turf, it'll mean war!

111.official: Shut your mouth and try me. I'll kill you!

113.literal: Don't ever show your face at this shop again.
113.official: don't show your face around this guy's shop again.

114.literal: S-So in the end... in place of that guy...
114.official: in the end you're just taking his place as the guy squeezing me for protection money?

117.literal: My parents' whereabouts, my daughter's school...
117.official: My parents' home address, my daughter's school...

118.literal: It's the building my place was originally in.
118.official: The place my cafe was in.

119.official: The Hakua Building on Shichifuku Street.

120.literal: Most of the shops have moved out and it's nearly empty, but...
120.official: They've driven most of the tenants out, so the place is practically empty,

121.literal: There was one stubborn holdout of a shop.
121.official: there was one stubborn guy who said the only way he was leaving was in a casket.

122.literal: That's right. No matter how good the terms he was offered...
122.official: They were making him all kinds of sweet deals, but he turned down every last one.

123.literal: If you go there, you'll probably run into those guys.
123.official: If he's still there now, Tachibana's boys will be, too. Go have a look if you really want to get mixed up with them.

124.literal: I see... Understood. You've been a big help.
124.official: All right, thanks. I appreciate it.

125.literal: What happened to the rest of your homeless buddies?
125.official: Hey. Where'd all your other buddies go?

126.literal: They said their work here was already done, so...
126.official: They told us this one's all done.

127.literal: 'Cause Tachibana's outfit runs a wide operation.
127.official: Tachibana-san's got his fingers in all sortsa pies.
